transcript: The most annoying part about content creation is setting up the lights, studio, and camera at the perfect angles to get a great shot. So to solve that problem, I built a free website using Replit where you can set up your camera and lights virtually and see how your real footage will look like. You can customize it to match your room dimensions and change the furniture to match your space. Then you can place the camera where you would put in real life. You can choose from different cameras and lenses to match the gear you already own, or you can even select phone. Now, you can choose from different lighting options, add lights, and adjust their height and angle to find what looks best for your footage. Whether you prefer to sit at a desk or stand, you can adjust the person's position to match. You can also switch between different aspect ratios for Reels and YouTube videos. But the craziest part is this whole app was built in 20 minutes with just one prompt. So if you ever feel stuck with the problem, just vibe code the solution. And if you want to try this app, just comment "Studio", and I'll send you the link.
caption:
Content creation could be tiring… setting up studio, lights and camera… 

So I built a virtual studio (but real) 😅
